subjects.title: Source intent remains explicit
subjects.statement: A proposed authored traceability obligation identifies its retained source intent or authoring request; inferred requirements and engineering choices are labeled separately, and an unresolved source cannot be presented as a canonical derivation.

subjects.title: Each obligation retains requested identity
subjects.statement: Each authored observation obligation retains the specification, rule, component and implementation attribution requested for that target, independently of sibling obligations. A complete sibling or root summary cannot supply an omitted declaration.

subjects.title: Authoring preserves requested meaning
subjects.statement: Refinement and projection preserve the selected authoring requirements and expose omission or ambiguous renaming for review; executor edits do not silently remove a requested traceability obligation. This does not mandate a global profile.

subjects.title: Mapping scope and coverage are explicit
subjects.statement: An authored mapping identifies its intended rule scope, authoritative mapping location and full or partial coverage claim. Exact reference validity is distinct from coverage; full coverage requires every rule in the declared scope to have a resolved mapping, while partial coverage identifies each uncovered rule by exact identity. Root delegation does not require copied participant rules; many-to-many mappings remain possible.

subjects.title: Scenario attribution requires a real harness
subjects.statement: A scenario attribution is conditional on an actual harness binding. Ordinary runtime observations without a tagged harness do not receive fabricated scenario identities; declarations and test references do not establish test execution.

subjects.title: Declaration checks retain evidence boundaries
subjects.statement: Successful authored-declaration checks establish only their declared structural scope. They do not establish actual runtime propagation, implementation conformance, executed or passing tests, evidence admission, or canonical approval. Diagnostic collection must not alter product behavior.

subjects.title: Source attribution and design separation
subjects.statement: Retains explicit source intent for each proposed requirement and distinguishes requested observation attribution from profile engineering choices.

subjects.title: Independent obligation preservation
subjects.statement: Defines per-obligation preservation of requested identity and authoring context so sibling declarations or candidate edits cannot silently satisfy omitted obligations.

subjects.title: Explicit mapping scope and coverage
subjects.statement: Defines explicit rule mapping scope and distinguishes exact reference validity from full or partial coverage without duplicating delegated rules.

subjects.title: Harness attribution and evidence limits
subjects.statement: Preserves harness-only scenario attribution, diagnostic non-interference and the distinction between authored declarations and executed or admitted evidence.

canonical_traceability.proposed_requirement_root_paths: Explicit directed derived_from edges for six Requirements to three proposed Intent roots; only candidate topology is checked.
canonical_traceability.criterion_boundary: Four criteria are acceptance revision targets, not new seed kinds. acceptance_criteria_refs does not itself establish an SG-SPEC-0061 canonical trace path; no criterion INV-002 closure is claimed.

publication_support.Requirement_and_criterion_storage: Existing SG-SPEC-0069 reader/writer and mandatory recorded-decision gate; pending candidates are intentionally not writer input.
publication_support.intent_roots: Logical existing kind intent; physical binding and publication route remain unimplemented by this slice.
publication_support.derived_from_edges: Valid proposed requirement-to-intent endpoint kinds under SG-SPEC-0023; external relation storage/admission is not implemented by subject_source_write v1.
publication_support.atomic_complete_chain_publication: No existing writer publishes this whole chain. Do not publish only the supported subset and claim canonical Intent closure.

decisions_requested: Confirm each normalized Intent interpretation against the retained verbatim human quote, without upgrading assistant capture to attestation.
Review six unchanged Requirement statements, four exact criterion statements, new proposed origin identities and the explicit shared criterion membership.
Review eight proposed directed derived_from edges and their source bases; no generic relation or proposal citation substitutes for an edge.
Review the supported storage candidates separately from the missing Intent/edge publication binding; this packet alone does not authorize a writer request.
decision_lifecycle: Keep reviewed packet and pending templates immutable after approval; record actual human decisions in a separate artifact bound to reviewed_head, packet raw SHA-256 and approval_scope_sha256. Any resolved adoption/provenance fields require a newly reviewed candidate/packet; do not fill them after approval.
